Loss-of-function mutations in SGCG disrupt the assembly and function of the dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, leading to progressive muscle weakness characteristic of both congenital muscular dystrophy and autosomal recessive limb-girdle muscular dystrophy.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in SGCG with a clear loss-of-function effect in both diseases, and absence of pathogenic variants in SGCG in individuals with these phenotypes but lacking the specific muscle weakness patterns described. _(variant: The presence of common benign variants in SGCG in gnomAD that are inconsistent with a loss-of-function mechanism for both diseases.)_
